set.body:
Pre-register the court before implementation results can influence it.

Acceptance criteria:
AC-431-01: Publish a versioned machine-readable protocol covering scenario seeds, shapes, full affines, motion trajectories, nuisance parameters, reference policy, masks, interpolators, repetitions, thread counts, and stage boundaries.
AC-431-02: Register each metric's units, direction, aggregation, tolerance, materiality threshold, claim or diagnostic role, and missing-value policy.
AC-431-03: Define absolute gates for analytic and noisy truth fixtures plus the comparative pass rule for AFNI and MCFLIRT without post-hoc metric selection.
AC-431-04: Record dataset checksums, provenance and license constraints, comparator pin requirements, and receipt schema.
AC-431-05: The protocol explicitly rejects negated Euler columns, spacing-only coordinates, self-resampler truth, native tSNR or DVARS as accuracy truth, and one-shot timing as acceptance evidence.
set.title: Freeze the external benchmark protocol, fixtures, and metric registry
